scope: Static, schema and safety review of the future live-image measurement helper only. No live execution or delivery acceptance.

findings.schema: Fields consumed by the JavaScript helper match verify-live-combined.py: route/file/hash/status, image url/local_url/file/local_file/bytes/hashes, deployment evidence and expected release, contract and local report hashes. Both PASS and REVIEW_DIFFERENCES are accepted capture states; neither becomes automatic visual acceptance.
findings.release_gate: Requires explicit full merge and positive deployment run, exactly the five intended successful routes, successful deployment proof with matching run/head/hash, and a completed matching combined local report.
findings.image_pairing: Uses every actual captured pair. It requires the four selected/affected base assets and unchanged sharing asset but does not impose a fixed total image count or require responsive live/local URLs to be identical. Captured content-address prefixes, hashes, sizes and geometry are verified. Existing actual responsive substitutions are therefore allowed while unknown normalization is not introduced.
findings.measurement: Both files use the same installed Sharp/libvips decoder, normalized orientation and sRGB RGBA. Reports byte identity separately from decoded identity; changed_channels and mean/max/RMS explicitly refer to the four-channel decoded array. ICC/IPTC/XMP/EXIF byte lengths and hashes are independently reported. No encoding cause is inferred.
findings.evidence: Raw page hashes and image hashes are verified before measurement; raw report, contract and images are checked again afterwards. Existing capture files are not overwritten. Each invocation creates a new timestamped measurement directory with exclusive report/contact-sheet writes; failure status is retained.
findings.filesystem_network: No network calls, publication, Git or source writes occur. Image reads are restricted to the recorded Olasuni raw directory and dist-publish paths. Deployment evidence is an explicitly recorded local read. New contact sheets and reports are generated evidence, not source copies.
findings.visual_limits: Contact sheets are labelled local-left/live-right and preserve complete frames on white at a reduced display size. Actual source files remain necessary for detailed inspection. Alpha handling and resized sheets do not establish pixel equality or subjective quality.

limitations: Static review and the parent-reported syntax check do not establish execution success.
Future independent delivery review must verify fresh actual captures, inspect all changed pairs and explain any remaining HTML differences; this helper does not replace that review.

The helper trusts the reviewed HTTP producer to enumerate article/card pairs. Independent live review must check actual emitted image coverage rather than relying solely on the expected base-image subset.
Combined final package, exact hosted checks and successful deployment remain prerequisites.
